column1: # Hand-written invocations for upstream tests the harvester cannot replay.
# Same columns as the harvest (module, key, source, args...). These tests build
# their inputs at test time, or loop over --partial values, so their `main([...])`
# calls either name files that never exist or do not resolve. `@GEN@` is the
# directory `generated_fixtures.py` fills once per sweep (upstream's own helpers);
# `@DATA@` and `@TMP@` are as in the harvest. Keys are `extra:<upstream test>#<n>`, and
# `known_gaps.tsv` tracks them like any other invocation.
# Upstream 1.0's shared selection contract (taxonomy filters with --taxonomy_unknown,
# alone). Upstream tests these through library calls, so these stand in for them.
# test_deduplicate_genbank_hash is parametrized over --identity and its --id alias.
